top_signals.title: Trump’s embrace of AI data centers adds to GOP’s midterm peril
top_signals.summary: Over the past few months, political strategists have warned Trump administration officials they were in danger of losing the public opinion war over data centers.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
